title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Addition for Hours Beyond Those the Visit Price Covers
content:
## Technician time ruling

**Which visit is priced.** The visits beyond the visits the term credited are the completions that follow, in the order they were completed, once as many completions as the term credited have been consumed, a visit closed as no-access consuming none; the visit priced is the most recent visit completed on the agreement, being the latest of those completions not yet charged.

**The hours that the price covers.** The additional visit price of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record covers 3.0 hours of technician time on the visit. An addition is made where the visit ran longer than that, counted on the hours logged for the visit priced against the hours that price covers.

### The ladder

| Reading | Addition made |
|---|---|
| the hours logged run beyond the 3.0 hours covered and the owner holds no demand service rate program under the Demand Service Rate Programs standing in active status | the tier's agreement labor rate is charged for each hour beyond those covered and added to the unit price |
| the hours logged run beyond the 3.0 hours covered and the owner holds a demand service rate program under the Demand Service Rate Programs standing in active status | the tier's agreement labor rate less the tier's repair labor discount is charged for each hour beyond those covered and added to the unit price |
| the hours logged do not run beyond the 3.0 hours covered | nothing is added for hours run beyond the hours that price covers |

The hours beyond those covered are the hours logged for the visit priced less the 3.0 hours the price covers; where the hours logged are 3.0 or fewer, there are none.

### Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- A visit logged at 5.0 hours at a tier whose agreement labor rate is 136.00 USD an hour, the owner holding no demand service rate program in active status: 2.0 hours run beyond the 3.0 covered, so 136.00 USD multiplied by 2.0, that is 272.00 USD, is added to the unit price.
- The same visit where the owner holds a demand service rate program in active status, at a tier whose repair labor discount is 10 percent: the rate charged is 136.00 USD less 10 percent of it, that is 122.40 USD an hour, so 244.80 USD is added.
- A visit logged at 2.5 hours: nothing is added for hours run beyond the hours that price covers.
